match: any Platonic solid — cube/box, tetrahedron, octahedron, dodecahedron, icosahedron; labels like "3d cube", "3d box", "platonic", or a rough 3D wireframe sketch of a regular solid
params: {"solid": "Tetrahedron"|"Cube"|"Octahedron"|"Dodecahedron"|"Icosahedron"; "flat": true|false — start flattened/unfolded; "slice": true|false — open the slicing plane; "tilt": 0-180, "offset": -1.4..1.4, "spin": 0-360, "cut": "full"|"above"|"below"} — all optional
